gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: The 325-seat Fillmore Town Theatre is located at 338 Central Avenue in Fillmore, CA. We are located within 20 minutes of a 500,000+ population including the cities of Ventura, Oxnard, Camarillo, Thousand Oaks, Moorpark, Simi Valley, Santa Clarita, Castaic, and Santa Paula. And we’re only 40 minutes northwest of Los Angeles!
